target: MIPS32r2 little-endian o32 soft-float, static Linux executable; simulated relay
gn_args:
target_os = "linux"
target_cpu = "mipsel"
custom_toolchain = "custom"
target_cc = "/opt/staging/toolchain-mipsel_24kc_gcc-13.3.0_musl/bin/mipsel-openwrt-linux-gcc"
target_cxx = "/opt/staging/toolchain-mipsel_24kc_gcc-13.3.0_musl/bin/mipsel-openwrt-linux-g++"
target_ar = "/opt/staging/toolchain-mipsel_24kc_gcc-13.3.0_musl/bin/mipsel-openwrt-linux-ar"
target_cflags = [
  "-march=24kec",
  "-msoft-float",
  "-mabi=32",
]
enable_pie = false
target_ldflags = [
  "-static",
  "-specs=/work/toolchains/mips-static.specs",
  "-march=24kec",
  "-msoft-float",
  "-mabi=32",
]
chip_crypto = "mbedtls"
is_debug = false
chip_support_thread_meshcop = false
symbol_level = 0
matter_enable_tracing_support = false
is_clang = false
chip_inet_config_enable_ipv4 = true
chip_config_network_layer_ble = false
chip_enable_wifi = false
chip_enable_thread = false
chip_mdns = "minimal"
